_comment: PURPOSE: OBSERVE the user's actual symptom -- 'why are all my buildings 1 turn' -- on the Build Manager surface itself. Run with --save none.
NO posted click anywhere in this file: a posted in-game click is process-lethal (0xC0000005, ~5 runs). Injection only.

Switch to Buildings. Tab checkboxes live under the ItemsBox group, not directly on the window: BuildEditorWindow.ItemsBox.BuildingsButton. The list's 'Time' column (str_ldl_Time, switch1) is the number the user photographed.
Wonders too -- their retune was never broken, so this is the control arm: if wonder turn counts look sane and buildings do not, the fix did not land.
